msg.sender may be from/to in external transfer calls

_transfer uses tx.origin for transfer delay mapping
constructor calls factory, createPair and WETH on router
_transfer calls swapBack when swap conditions met
swapBack sends leftover ETH to marketingWallet
swapBack performs token and ETH allocation arithmetic
updateBuyFees computes buyTotalFees as sum of fees
buyTotalFees equals marketing plus liquidity plus buyback plus dev
updateSellFees computes sellTotalFees as sum of fees
sellTotalFees equals marketing plus liquidity plus buyback plus dev
fees times marketing fee divided by total fees added to tokensForMarketing
fees times liquidity fee divided by total fees added to tokensForLiquidity
fees times buyback fee divided by total fees added to tokensForBuyBack
fees times dev fee divided by total fees added to tokensForDev
swapBack computes liquidityTokens and ETH splits
ethForMarketing computed from ethBalance and tokensForMarketing
ethForDev computed from ethBalance and tokensForDev
ethForBuyBack computed from ethBalance and tokensForBuyBack
ethForLiquidity computed by subtracting other ETH allocations
